public static final class StructuredTaskScope.TimeoutException extends RuntimeException
TimeoutException is a preview API of the Java platform.
Programs can only use TimeoutException when preview features are enabled.
Preview features may be removed in a future release, or upgraded to permanent features of the Java platform.
Exception thrown by StructuredTaskScope.join()预览 if the scope was created with a timeout and the timeout expired before or while waiting in join.
